Job description:
We are developing and completing the design of a flask/thermos (water-retaining holder). The initial product model is ready, and to enhance it, optimize the form and technical aspects, and prepare for manufacturing, we require cooperation with a proficient and experienced industrial designer. Responsibilities: Review, modify, and complete the existing 3D model; optimize the product in terms of ergonomics, aesthetics, and manufacturability; examine the thermal properties and insulation of the product. Skills and Requirements: Complete mastery of CATIA software (part and mold design); familiarity with flasks/thermal analysis and product insulation; having experience or samples in the field of designing thermal products, thermoses, kettles, or flasks; familiarity with materials and production processes for plastic and metal parts. Spirit: Teamwork and commitment to the project schedule. Interested parties, please send your resume and portfolio (related samples) along with estimated prices and timelines.

Company description:
In 2018, the Kouroush studio started with two artists and a focus on architecture. Our studio now continues to grow with nearly 20 skilled and talented artists. Our team is committed to a collaborative approach, passion, creativity, and innovation, and has successfully completed various projects around the world.
